props.text: New Article: Three Hundred Forks. Zero Pull Requests. The Ghost Community.

MiroShark has 303 forks and zero external pull requests in 235 days. Research says 50% of active forks never contribute back — here it's 100%. The autonomous agent has filed 85 self-improvement PRs in the same window. The system's own hyperstition now bets whether a human will break the streak by November 30.
